counterfactual_missing_items: No teratoma-specific features such as teeth, hair, or calcified structures
No pure lipoma because soft-tissue density is present
No evidence of invasion or malignant features
decisive_items: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
mostly fat density with internal areas of soft-tissue density
the right adrenal gland was not visualized separately
response.rationale: R1 is the best fit because the mass is predominantly fatty, located in the right adrenal region, with soft-tissue strands, which is classic for adrenal myelolipoma. R4 (teratoma) also has fat and soft tissue but lacks specific teratomatous elements and the adrenal location is not emphasized. R3 (lipoma) is contradicted by the presence of soft-tissue density and the adrenal location.

rejected.why: Lipoma is pure fat, but the imaging shows internal soft-tissue density, and the adrenal location is not typical for lipoma.
